name: Hydrogel patch for temperature reduction, 2 pieces
description: Ready-to-use hydrogel patch, no refrigeration required, fast-acting, helps reduce fever in children and provides a feeling of relief and well-being for up to 8 hours. It is non-medicinal and can be used alongside medications. Image may vary depending on the final product and geographic area.
